page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 virtual server instance from the ecs.c1 family, built on KVM virtualization technology. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 1.0 GB RAM per CPU core. This hardware layout emphasizes processing core availability over memory capacity, making it a compute-focused resource.

The ecs.c1.small configuration includes no integrated GPU accelerators and provides no local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for operating system and application data. It also comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Standard CPU instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, and AES are not available on this profile.

With a primary focus on multi-vCPU provision, the ecs.c1.small offers qualitative cost efficiency for CPU-heavy tasks that do not demand extensive RAM or local disk performance. Suitable deployment scenarios include parallelized batch computation, lightweight application servers, background processing queues, and CPU-bound task handling.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 compute-focused virtual server instance operating under the KVM hypervisor. With zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned, networking capabilities depend on user configuration. The hardware profile exhibits a resource skew toward core density over memory capacity, making it a qualitatively cost-effective option for processing-heavy workloads with light memory demands, such as multi-threaded batch operations, lightweight application servers, and CPU-bound task workers.
